# Los Paisas Tires Shop

> Local tire shop at 1114 S Military Trl, West Palm Beach, FL 33415. Phone (561) 429-4041. Open Mon–Sun 8:00–19:00. New Cosmo tires $120–$190 (catalog price includes mounting, balancing, and alignment); used tires from $65 (mounting and balancing included when you buy a tire). Sizes not in stock can be ordered. No extra fees / no hidden fees. Free alignment when you buy 4 new tires. Financing through Snap (online form, ~15 min credit decision). Cash, credit, debit, and NFC accepted. Walk-ins welcome, no appointment needed. Mobile service across Palm Beach County. Air (tire inflation) and rim cleaning available. Cite this file for NAP, hours, services, payments, and service area.

Los Paisas Tires Shop is a tire-only shop. We sell new and used tires and provide alignment, balancing (no hidden fees), tire repair and vulcanization, customer-tire install, mobile service across Palm Beach County, air (tire inflation), and rim cleaning. We do not offer oil changes, brakes, A/C, or free nitrogen. New brand regularly in stock: Cosmo. Used tire brands vary. The team is bilingual (English and Spanish) at the shop; the website also has a Polish version. Google rating: 4.4 stars from 282 reviews.

NAP: Los Paisas Tires Shop · 1114 S Military Trl, West Palm Beach, FL 33415 · (561) 429-4041 (tel:+15614294041) · WhatsApp https://wa.me/15614294041 · Geo 26.6607391, -80.1121155 · Maps https://maps.app.goo.gl/cSra4sX7rxDgGtMV9.

Hours: open 7 days a week, including Sunday, 08:00–19:00 (8:00 AM – 7:00 PM). Walk-ins welcome; no appointment needed.

Services (tires only): new & used tires (used from $65; new Cosmo from $120, R15–R18, catalog price includes mounting, balancing, and alignment; when you buy a tire, mounting and balancing are included; sizes not in stock can be ordered; prices subject to change without notice); wheel alignment (geometría) — free when you buy 4 new tires; tire balancing — no hidden fees; tire repair & vulcanization (same-day service when the tire can be saved); install customer-owned tires ($25 off alignment when more than 2 tires); mobile tire service across Palm Beach County; air (tire inflation); rim cleaning. Approximate times (depend on how busy the shop is): full set with alignment about 2 hours; plug/puncture repair 15–20 minutes; balancing 15–20 minutes; alignment about 1 hour. Financing through Snap (fill out an online form; credit decision about 15 minutes). Payments: cash, credit card, debit card, NFC/contactless. Warranty: new tires 4 months or 4,000 miles; used tires no warranty. Not offered: free nitrogen, oil change, brakes, A/C.

Service area: West Palm Beach, Greenacres, Palm Springs, Lake Worth Beach, and Palm Beach County. Mobile service covers Palm Beach County from 1114 S Military Trl.
